name: Attestation Campaign
description: One attestation event. Three campaign types, one engine. The population is derived from live data at generation time; the stored filter is what makes that derivation reproducible.

fields.label: Campaign Type
fields.options:
Forum Inventory
Governing Document
Forum Owner And Compliance

fields.label: Period Label
fields.description: Unique with campaign type. The attestation year, normally.

fields.label: Population Filter
fields.description: Stored, not recomputed, so the population that was attested can be reproduced.

fields.label: Participant Source
fields.options:
Record Field
Seat Role
Registered Source
fields.description: How the accountable person for each record in the population is resolved. Record Field reads a user field on the record; Seat Role reads a dated seat table; Registered Source asks a resolver a module registers by name, for populations neither of the other two can express, such as everyone a document applies to.

fields.label: Participant Field
fields.description: The fieldname on the target record holding the accountable user.

fields.label: Participant Resolver
fields.description: The name a module registers its resolver under (the consilium_attestation_participants hook). A name, never a code path: an unknown name is refused.

fields.label: Second Signatory Field
fields.description: The fieldname on the target record holding the second signatory, where dual signature is required.

fields.label: Seat DocType
fields.description: The dated seat table, e.g. the forum membership record.

fields.label: Seat Role Field
fields.description: The seat's link to Governance Forum Role. Only roles flagged can_attest are drawn.

fields.label: Seat End Date Field
fields.description: Seats with an end date on or before the generation date are not drawn.

fields.label: Status
fields.description: A label. Business logic reads the semantic flags below, never this string.

fields.label: Is Open
fields.description: Semantic flag derived from Workflow State Flag. Tasks are generated only while open.
